title: Autonomous writers reach main only through kbgit.py sync --push
goal: kb/_self/git.md names kbgit.py sync --push as the only path by which an autonomous writer (query-log apply, and research or ingest when they push on their own) reaches origin's main, with the automatic revert and bug item on a red pipeline; tests.py -k autonomous_write proves that each of them pushes only through kbgit.py sync --push (a planted direct git push in a fixture writer fails the test) and that a red automatic push is reverted and files one bug.

gates.question: By which path do autonomous writers reach origin's main? Research and ingest do not push on their own until this is answered.
options: direct push through kbgit.py sync --push, with the automatic revert and bug on a red pipeline (today's path)
branch, merge request, merged-results pipeline, auto-merge when green
merge request for research and ingest, direct push for the query log's small fixes
gates.recommendation: branch, merge request, merged-results pipeline, auto-merge when green
gates.answer: direct push through kbgit.py sync --push, with the automatic revert and bug on a red pipeline (today's path)
